method: 20000 CPU-only empirical planning draws of completed-question paired dispatch durations; active residual lengths sampled from same-period completed lengths at least as long as current progress. Max of fixed GPU queues. No experiment/answer selection or source changes.
limitations: Available completed cases may bias short; remaining questions are different and not exchangeable guarantees
EOS length unpredictable; no fixed totalwall/GPUh cap
Current token rates may change; cap scenario conditional on unchanged rates, not a guaranteed deadline
Final CPU scoring/archive/independent review extra time not measured here
